title: Nasikya in the Mahabharata World: The Ancient Nashik Region on the Upper Godavari
description: For our Mahabharata geographical map, Nasikya can be associated broadly with Nashik and adjoining northern Maharashtra, particularly the upper Godavari country around Nashik, Trimbakeshwar and the surrounding plateau. Its boundaries must nevertheless be shown as approximate rather than as a precisely documented Mahabharata kingdom. title: Saqqara excavation uncovers false door in ancient courtier tomb
description: Archaeologists unearthed burial chambers belonging to ancient royal officials in Saqqara on September 10, 2026. The structures display architectural techniques distinct from the stone pyramids built for Old Kingdom pharaohs.
